[Intro]
D D/G Bm7 G2

[Verse 1]
en: In Christ [D]alone, my [Bm]hope is [A]found
zh: 在基[D]督里我[Bm]得盼[A]望
py: zài jī dū lǐ wǒ de pàn wàng
en: [D/F#]He is my [G]light, my [A]strength, my [D]song
zh: [D/F#]祂是亮[G]光力[A]量诗[D]歌
py: tā shì liàng guāng lì liàng shī gē
en: This [G2]corner[D]stone, this [Bm]solid [A]ground
zh: 这[G2]房角[D]石 [Bm]坚固磐[A]石
py!: zhè fáng jiǎo shí jiān gù pán shí
en: [D/F#]Firm through the [G]fiercest [A]drought and [D]storm
zh: [D/F#]不怕干[G]旱凶[A]猛风[D]暴
py: bú pà gān hàn xiōng měng fēng bào

[Chorus 1]
en: What [D/F#]heights of [G]love, what [Bm]depth of [A]peace
zh: [D/F#]无比[G]慈爱[Bm]何等平[A]安
py: wú bǐ cí ài hé děng píng ān
en: When [D/F#]fears are [G]stilled, when [Bm]striving [A]cease
zh: [D/F#]惧怕[G]消逝[Bm]争战平[A]息
py: jù pà xiāo shì zhēng zhàn píng xī
en: My [G2]Comfor[D]ter, my [Bm]All in [A]all
zh: [G2]我的安[D]慰[Bm]我的一[A]切
py: wǒ de ān wèi wǒ de yí qiè
en: [D/F#]Here in the [G2]love of [A]Christ I [D]stand
zh: [D/F#]因主的[G2]爱[A]我得站[D]立
py: yīn zhǔ de ài wǒ de zhàn lì

[Verse 2]
{chords: Verse 1}
en: There in the ground, His body lay
zh: 祂的身体在洞穴里
py: tā de shēn tǐ zài dòng xué lǐ
en: Light of the world by darkness slain
zh: 世上之光在黑暗里
py: shì shàng zhī guāng zài hēi àn lǐ
en: Then bursting forth in glorious day
zh: 直到那日荣耀清晨
py: zhí dào nà rì róng yào qīng chén
en: Up from the grace He rose again
zh: 从坟墓里祂又复活
py: cóng fén mù lǐ tā yòu fù huó

[Chorus 2]
{chords: Chorus 1}
en: And as He stands in victory
zh: 当祂胜过罪恶权势
py: dāng tā shèng guò zuì è quán shì
en: Sin’s curse has lost its grip on me
zh: 死亡毒勾不再害我
py: sǐ wáng dú gōu bú zài hài wǒ
en: For I am His and He is mine
zh: 我属于祂祂属于我
py: wǒ shǔ yú tā tā shǔ yú wǒ
en: Bought with the precious blood of Christ
zh: 因主宝血我得救赎
py: yīn zhǔ bǎo xuè wǒ de jiù shú

[Verse 3]
{chords: Verse 1}
en: No guilt in life, no fear in death
zh: 胜过罪恶不惧死亡
py: shèng guò zuì è bú jù sǐ wáng
en: This is the power of Christ in me
zh: 基督大能今护庇我
py: jī dū dà néng jīn hù bì wǒ
en: From life’s first cry to final breath
zh: 从我诞生直到离世
py: cóng wǒ dàn shēng zhí dào lí shì
en: Jesus commands my destiny
zh: 我的生命在主手里
py: wǒ de shēng mìng zài zhǔ shǒu lǐ

[Chorus 3]
{chords: Chorus 1}
en: No power of hell, no scheme of man
zh: 没有邪恶或是权谋
py: méi yǒu xié è huò shì quán móu
en: Can ever pluck me from His hand
zh: 能使我们与神隔绝
py: néng shǐ wǒ men yǔ shén gé jué
en: Till He returns or calls me home
zh: 直到主来或归天家
py: zhí dào zhǔ lái huò guī tiān jiā
en: Here in the power of Christ I’ll stand
zh: 因主大能我得站立
py: yīn zhǔ dà néng wǒ de zhàn lì

en: [Bm7]I find my peace, [G2]in Christ alone
